scope: Pure decoder for one bounded public Environment Agency rainfall response. Not a farm reading, country coverage assertion, forecast, currentness/quality assessment or crop-planner input.

provider.name: Environment Agency public rainfall network sample
provider.attribution: this uses Environment Agency rainfall data from the real-time data API (Beta)
provider.access: Product documentation states open data without registration. Exact fetched public endpoint returned HTTP200; no authenticated capability implied.
provider.licence: Product-specific Open Government Licence link; OGLv3 permits commercial/noncommercial reuse subject to attribution and exclusions, without endorsement or continued-supply guarantee.
provider.cadence: Accumulated precipitation per 15-minute period; commonly transferred once or twice daily. Latest means latest available per measure, not necessarily current.
provider.coverage: Rainfall-specific national boundaries not established by inspected documents. No England-only, UK-wide, farm-nearest or complete network coverage claim.

provenance.fetchedAt: supplied opaque receipt text, nonblank trimmed-equal string <=100 characters; invalid input produces null and failed/invalid-provenance; never read clock or claim independently verified retrieval

decodeRules: Use existing detachJsonData on unknown payload; catch unsafe descriptors/cycles/functions/reflection errors. No second JSON detacher or caller getter execution; no network/storage/clock/Date operations.

Root and meta must be objects; meta.limit must exactly equal1. items must be an array length0 or1. More than1, malformed root/meta/items or malformed row => failed/malformed-response; no silent skip/truncation.
Empty items => unavailable/no-reading, no reading member. No invented zero or previously cached result.

Single row must be object with object measure parameter exactly rainfall, unitName exactly mm, period exactly900 and valueType exactly total. Unsupported/missing measurement metadata => failed/unsupported-measurement, no reading.

Row value ABSENT => rainfallMm null and partial. Present value must be finite numeric >=0; preserve genuine0. Null/string/boolean/nonfinite/negative values => failed/malformed-response. Never derive quantity from date/qualifier/text.

Row dateTime ABSENT => reportedAt null and partial. Present dateTime must be nonblank trimmed-equal string <=100 characters, retained exactly, otherwise failed/malformed-response. It is opaque reported text, NOT independently verified timestamp/calendar/UTC freshness or interval-boundary evidence. No parser, arithmetic, conversion or date fallback.

Valid single row => available when both value/dateTime present, otherwise partial; available means structurally decoded reference only. reading contains ONLY reportedAt:string|null, rainfallMm:number|null, periodSeconds:900, units:mm, valueType:total.

Result contains only common provenance/sample and discriminant-specific fields. failed has reason invalid-provenance|malformed-response|unsupported-measurement and no reading; unavailable has reason no-reading and no reading; available|partial has reading and no reason.

Ignore inbound extra metadata/URLs/station IDs/coordinates in projection; return no provider-supplied links, location/contact or mutable input aliases. Static provider object is frozen; fresh returned objects cannot mutate shared provider or another call. Readonly public types. No arbitrary station fetch or arbitrary endpoint.

Software fixed-query one-item policy is not official quota. Future server transport must separately bound bytes/deadline and caller geography; decoder alone is NOT live integration or retrieval/authentication proof.

sourceFacts.missingValueMeaning: JSON NaN readings omit value; absence remains unknown.
sourceFacts.latestMeaning: latest available reading for each included measure
unknowns: whether reported timestamp marks accumulation start or end

testRequirements: actual source-shape zero versus absent value
each measurement mismatch and malformed row holds
one-item limit enforced without silent drop
raw reported/receipt strings preserved without time arithmetic
opaque timestamp policy clear, no false validation claim
unsafe getter0 calls and caller data unchanged
import and calls no clock/storage/network; meaningful failing-access control
returned projection excludes location/station/arbitrary URLs and does not alias input
